subject: Post-call recap: Meridian Financial security fit-gap & evidence plan
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.in>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@meridian-fin.com>, Sara Li <sara.li@meridian-fin.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.in>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Meridian call recap — security fit-gap / next steps

Alex / Sara — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side with the specific asks and proposed owners so we all have the same record. Please call out any corrections.

Top pain & acceptance signals you shared
- Audit log and retention: need immutable audit logs retained for 7 years for regulatory reporting across core payment flows.
- SOC 2 Type II is a must; Meridian needs evidence that controls were operating across the last 12 months.
- Pen test: internal vendor-run pen test window + evidence of remediation and retest results.
- Data handling: US-only residency for customer PII and support for a DPA with specific retention clauses.
- Auth & access: SAML SSO + per-token audit trail required for forensic debug.

Goals we agreed on
1) Confirm Redwood can meet SOC 2 written evidence + provide audit-log sample within 2 weeks.
2) Surface a one-page retention proposal compatible with your 7-year requirement.
3) Draft a DPA redline for Meridian legal to review.
4) Schedule a 30-minute technical follow-up (Ben + Meridian infra) to align on audit log schema and anonymized extract.

Proposed next steps / owners (short timeline)
- IR: deliver SOC2 summary + SOC2 report access link (Irene) — target: 2027-04-05
- BEN: produce list of artifacts and a scrubbed sample audit-log CSV (Ben Carter) — target: 2027-04-02
- JORDAN: pricing/contract touchpoint and procurement intro (Jordan Blake) — target: 2027-04-06
- Meridian: share legal contact + preferred DPA redline comments (Alex / Sara) — target: 2027-04-08

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (abridged), audit-log-sample.csv (anonymized stub) — attaching the two stubs for your intake.

Open questions we flagged
- Are there specific retention encryption controls (CMKs) required by Meridian?
- Does your procurement team prefer DocuSign or an emailed redline?

If that looks good I’ll schedule the technical follow-up for Ben + your infra team for next week.

Thanks,

Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.in | +1 (415) 555-0142

--
Irene Choi
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@meridian-fin.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.in>
Cc: Sara Li <sara.li@meridian-fin.com>, procurement@meridian-fin.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian call recap — security fit-gap / next steps

Thanks Irene — this is perfect and captures everything we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- On retention: 7 years is firm for the specific transaction logs used for dispute resolution; other analytics events can be shorter. We will provide the exact list of event types by April 6.
- On SOC2: we require the latest Type II report and the associated user control narrative (not just the summary). Is that something you can provide or point us to a view-only portal?
- On pen test: Meridian runs an annual pen test; we need to see your last external pen test report plus remediation notes. If Redwood uses third-party pentests, include scope and dates.

Procurement (procurement@meridian-fin.com) — we’ll need a preliminary SOW and ballpark numbers to start a budget approval. Jordan, can you own that and send to procurement?

I’m available for a technical sync Thurs 10–11am PT if that works for your team.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — aim to keep the timeline tight since this is on our Q2 intake.

Best,
Alex Turner
Head of Infrastructure Security | Meridian Financial
alex.turner@meridian-fin.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.in>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@meridian-fin.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.in>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.in>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian call recap — security fit-gap / next steps

Alex — adding a short technical evidence checklist so procurement and infra have a concrete ask list. I’ll own producing the artifacts marked with (REDWOOD).

Required evidence (initial deliverables)
- SOC 2 Type II report (latest cycle) + control narrative (REDWOOD)
- Penetration test report (last external test) + remediation summary (REDWOOD)
- Audit log sample: anonymized CSV containing columns: timestamp, user_id_hash, action, resource_id, request_id (REDWOOD)
- Retention policy (policy doc describing retention windows and deletion workflow) (REDWOOD)
- DPA template and proposed redline summary (LEGAL - IRENE to coordinate legal handoff)
- KMS usage summary: outline of default encryption at rest and options for customer-managed keys (REDWOOD)

Technical question: for the audit-log sample we will strip any PII and replace identifiers with consistent hashes. Alex — can you confirm which columns Meridian needs in raw form for your forensic tooling? If you can share a sample ingestion schema I’ll format accordingly.

Coordination: I’ll upload artifacts to the Drive link Irene included and put a README with artifact dates & brief notes.

Ben Carter
Security Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.in
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.in>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@meridian-fin.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.in>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.in>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian call recap — security fit-gap / next steps

Thanks all — confirmed on both sides. Quick logistics: 

- Ben: please upload artifacts to https://drive.google.com/meridian-ddq-2027 and mark each file with a README that includes the generation date and point of contact.
- Alex: Thurs 10am PT technical sync is locked. I’ll send a calendar invite with Ben + Jordan + Meridian infra.
- Jordan: please prepare the preliminary SOW / ballpark pricing (high/low) and send to procurement@meridian-fin.com before EOD 2027-04-06.

Irene — can your legal ops expect a redline from Meridian legal by 2027-04-08? If so we’ll prioritize DPA review that week.

Thanks again — goal is to have the core artifacts ingested into your procurement queue and to a follow-up exec touchpoint by 2027-04-12.

Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.in
